description: The Care Quality Commission's list of the places in England where care is regulated, covering hospitals, care homes, GPs, dentists and home care agencies, with their addresses and postcodes. It is published as a spreadsheet that the commission updates regularly.
name: CQC care directory (England)

recipe.reason: The CSV has a title and a production note above its header and its address contains the month it was produced, so it changes every month and has no stable download URL.
